result.strongest_objection: The closest concern is the coarse identity validation: because required identities are daemon-wide, a valid proof envelope that satisfies a subject's specific needs but lacks one of the daemon's global identities will be refused with 'proof_incomplete'. The design correctly mitigates this by rendering an honest reason ('does not verify every identity the daemon requires') rather than a fabricated failure, and explicitly scopes per-subject configuration as future work.
